description: This file defines a 'Filter' struct and associated methods for filtering Kubernetes resources using containerized processes, including command setup and execution logic.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A struct for filtering resources via containerized execution, embedding runtimeutil.ContainerSpec and including execution configuration.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the container filter, including defer failure info if applicable.

methods.name: GetExit
methods.description: Retrieves the exit status of the container execution.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a list of YAML nodes using the container execution specified in the Filter struct.

methods.name: setupExec
methods.description: Initializes the execution environment, setting working directory and command parameters.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command and arguments to run the container with appropriate options.

methods.name: NewContainer
methods.description: Creates a new Filter instance configured with specified container specifications and UID/GID.
